title: Keep a family’s root visible, and its requests close
overview: The Desk keeps the family root beside its leading request. The reader reveals the active children of that root.

areas.name: Reader
areas.what: Reveal active requests inside their family.

areas.name: Desk
areas.what: Keep the root beside the leading request.

flags.text: Check whether root and lead can be the same row.

chapters.title: Keep the root in sight
chapters.narrative: Both rows belong to the same family.
chapters.why_here: Establish the identity before rendering the requests.

stops.note: The root remains an address for the work.

chapters.title: Join the reader to that outline
chapters.narrative: Only active children appear in this projection.
chapters.why_here: The reader consumes the root selected by the Desk.

stops.note: Read the projection before its entry point.
The caller supplies the family root.
